title: Top hat with a smiling face
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- top hat with smiling face -->
  <!-- brim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="38" ry="9" fill="#7a3fb0"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="77" rx="38" ry="9" fill="#9d5fd6"/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x="24" y="18" width="52" height="58" rx="4" fill="#8a4cc4"/>
  <rect x="24" y="18" width="52" height="58" rx="4" fill="#a868e0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- top oval -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="18" rx="26" ry="7" fill="#b878ee"/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x="24" y="62" width="52" height="10" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <rect x="24" y="62" width="52" height="4" fill="#ffe58a"/>
  <!-- hat band buckle -->
  <rect x="45" y="60" width="10" height="14" rx="2" fill="#ff8c2b"/>
  <rect x="48" y="63" width="4" height="8" rx="1" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <!-- shiny highlight -->
  <rect x="30" y="24" width="7" height="30" rx="3" fill="#d3a4f5" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="54" r="4" fill="#eafcff"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="54" r="4" fill="#eafcff"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="55" r="1.8" fill="#2b1b3d"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="55" r="1.8" fill="#2b1b3d"/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="61" r="3" fill="#ff8fb0"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="61" r="3" fill="#ff8fb0"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 65 Q50 72 58 65" stroke="#eafcff" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
